description: This file implements the editors API for the Superset project, providing functions for registering, retrieving, and managing editor providers, as well as event handling for registration changes. It also exports components related to editors.

classes.name: EditorProviders
classes.description: Class managing registration and event handling for editor providers.

methods.name: registerEditorProvider
methods.description: Registers an editor provider for specific languages, returning a Disposable for unregistration.

methods.name: getEditorProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the editor provider for a specific language, if registered.

methods.name: hasEditorProvider
methods.description: Checks if an extension has registered an editor for a given language.

methods.name: onDidRegisterEditorProvider
methods.description: Subscribes to the event when an editor provider is registered.

methods.name: onDidUnregisterEditorProvider
methods.description: Subscribes to the event when an editor provider is unregistered.
